notes: Transmit/nominal wavelength 191.35–196.10 THz; receiver wavelength range 191.00–197.00 THz; 50 GHz steps (96 ch) D9135–D9610. Power budget 10–23 dB. Dispersion penalty max 3 dB. Output power, receiver sensitivity, and overload are average power (footnote 1). Rx sensitivity footnotes: 2) back-to-back @ 10.3 Gbps, BER 1×10⁻¹², OSNR >35 dB → -24.0 dBm; 3) +1100 ps/nm @ 10.3 Gbps, BER 1×10⁻¹², OSNR >35 dB → -23.0 dBm; 4) -300 to +1400 ps/nm @ 10.3 Gbps, BER 1×10⁻¹², OSNR >35 dB → -21.0 dBm. Tuning speed min 10 s channel-to-channel. Power consumption <2.3 W worst case. 10GBASE-ZR/ZW referenced for bridgeable distance; standard defined only at 1550 nm for other DWDM wavelengths.
suggestions: Clarify whether rx_osnr_db should capture only receiver OSNR requirements vs. test conditions (OSNR >35 dB). Dispersion penalty max 3 dB lacks paired penalized metric for penalties[] schema. Host/media MSA interface IDs not in this datasheet.
